column1: # ARM sext and immediate fusion control. Dynamic SHAPE instances use shared sections.
# Frame fusion requires adjacent instruction rows, matching stack offsets and widths 1/2/4.
# Immediate fusion falls back for unsupported magnitudes, aliases, labels or uncertain liveness.
# Dead-after scanning is bounded to 32 rows and instantiated from the live selected SHAPE set.
# shape_match/shape_read are shared templates, not copies per opcode.
